sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, this update publishes no new price, and the prices remain those of the confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 20:06 BRT, the last one published, with Flávio Bolsonaro at 83.75% (cumulative volume USD 27.06M) and Lula at 16.50% (cumulative volume USD 30.28M). Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula in that reading is 67.25pp. The contracts for the other names in the winner book have been closed since the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), resolved at zero. On 17/Oct, the consultancy Eurasia Group lowered from 80% to 75% the probability it assigns to a Flávio Bolsonaro victory, citing the smaller distance in the polls (Valor and CNN Brasil).
sentimento.text2: 📊 THE SECOND-ROUND POLLS. Three new national polls came out since the previous update, all with Flávio Bolsonaro ahead. Veritá, with 15,554 automated phone interviews from 19 to 23/Oct, released on 24/Oct, gives 49.44% to Flávio Bolsonaro and 46.46% to Lula in total votes and 51.56% to 48.44% in valid votes (Exame, R7 and Congresso em Foco). Futura/100% Cidades, with 2,000 phone interviews, released on the night of 24/Oct, gives 48.2% to 47.9% in total votes and 50.1% to 49.9% in valid votes (Exame and ND Mais). PoderData/Aya, with 4,000 automated phone interviews from 23 to 24/Oct, released on 25/Oct, gives 51% to 49% in valid votes and did not release total votes (Poder360 and VEJA). Against each pollster's previous wave, in total votes, Veritá goes from 50.2% to 47.5% to 49.44% to 46.46%, with both names falling and the distance going from 2.7 to 2.98 points, and Futura/100% Cidades goes from 48.9% to 46.8% to 48.2% to 47.9%, with Lula rising and the distance going from 2.1 to 0.3 point; in valid votes, PoderData/Aya repeats the 51% to 49% of the 19 to 21/Oct wave. The previous update, of 24/Oct at 20:06 BRT, added the six national polls released on the night of 24/Oct, all with Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in total votes by 1 to 3 points: 48% to 47% in Datafolha, 46% to 45% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), 49.9% to 48.4% in AtlasIntel, 50% to 49% in Palver, 47% to 46% in BTG/Nexus and 49% to 46% in Gerp. Of the fifty-five national polls conducted after the vote, fifty put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, forty-five of them by 0.3 to 9 points in total votes and five by 2 to 4 points in valid votes; four put Lula ahead in total votes, the three Vox Brasil polls, of 09/Oct, 18/Oct and 23/Oct, by 1.5, 1.8 and 1.1 points, and Colectta of 24/Oct, by 0.5 point, and PoderData/Aya of 16/Oct measured a tie in valid votes. On rejection, 46% would not vote for Lula and 45% would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro in Datafolha of 24/Oct (Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo and CNN Brasil), and in Quaest of 24/Oct 49% reject Flávio Bolsonaro, against 52% in the previous wave, and 47% reject Lula (CNN Brasil and O Globo). In Datafolha of 24/Oct, among voters with a high propensity to vote, 76% of the electorate, Flávio Bolsonaro has 52% of the valid votes and Lula 48%, and among those with a low or medium propensity Lula has 52% and Flávio Bolsonaro 48% (CartaCapital, InfoMoney and CNN Brasil). In PoderData/Aya of 25/Oct, 98% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters and 93% of Lula's say they will not switch candidates, and 51% think Flávio Bolsonaro has the better chance of winning, against 43% who point to Lula (Poder360 and VEJA). The voters of Augusto Cury, who declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct, go to him by 56% to 27% in PoderData/Aya of 13/Oct and by 50% to 29% in Ipespe of 10/Oct, and to Lula by 50.4% to 38.9% in AtlasIntel of 09/Oct. Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, all three point to Flávio Bolsonaro. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally of 05/Oct, with 100% of polling sections, Flávio Bolsonaro had 47.03% of the valid votes and Lula 45.16%. PoderData/Aya is the only national poll with a release registered with the TSE for 25/Oct, election day, and there is no national poll registered after it. 🗳️ The second-round vote is today, 25/Oct. By 12:00 BRT, the TSE had replaced 900 electronic voting machines (Folha de S.Paulo, Agência Brasil and Poder360), and the court's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, expects the official announcement of the result between 20:30 and 21:00 BRT (Folha de S.Paulo, Valor and Metrópoles).
sentimento.text3: 🎙️ THE DEBATES, THE SECRECY CHALLENGE AND THE SECOND-ROUND ENDORSEMENTS. The first debate of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) was on Band, on 18/Oct, and the last, on Globo, on the night of 23/Oct. In Globo's, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro presented proposals and traded accusations (Agência Brasil and BBC), among them over Daniel Vorcaro, Willer Tomaz and public security (O Globo), and the fact-checking agency Lupa flagged 20 statements it considered inadequate and 11 entirely true (Folha de S.Paulo). In Datafolha of 24/Oct, 54% said they watched Globo's debate, in full or in part; 36% thought Lula did better and another 36% that Flávio Bolsonaro did better, and 98% said the debate did not change their vote (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). On 22/Oct, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro signed at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) a document authorizing the lifting of their bank, tax and phone secrecy, and on 23/Oct the two campaigns delivered the authorizations, without disclosing the data (UOL and O Globo). On 24/Oct, the Electoral Prosecutor General's Office argued for dismissing the case on lifting the secrecy, on the view that it is not for the Electoral Court to decide on the disclosure (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and G1). ⚖️ On 22/Oct, Justice Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, the TSE's inspector general, denied in an injunction ruling the request by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to suspend government messages sent via WhatsApp and Gov.br, among them notices about Bolsa Família, Farmácia Popular and the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) proof-of-life check, considering them of apparently informative content, and gave the parties five days to respond (CartaCapital, G1 and CNN Brasil). 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1). On 16/Oct, former Fortaleza mayor Roberto Cláudio declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro (G1). Renan Santos said on 15/Oct that he does not back Lula and will not vote (O Globo and Estadão). After the promulgation, Lula said the 6x1 work schedule will return if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the election (O Globo and Valor), and on 13/Oct he announced Prospera MEI, with forgiveness of individual microentrepreneurs' debts estimated at R$ 12.6 billion (Poder360 and Estadão). On 16/Oct Congress promulgated the constitutional amendment (PEC) ending the 6x1 work schedule, which cuts the maximum working week from 44 to 40 hours (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor), and Flávio Bolsonaro had said on 13/Oct that he would vote in favour (UOL and CNN Brasil). In BTG/Nexus of 19/Oct, 66.2% support ending the 6x1 schedule (UOL and Diário do Grande ABC). ⚖️ On 18/Oct, Estadão reported, and Folha de S.Paulo and G1 confirmed, that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) (PF) took to the Supreme Court an investigation into suspected money laundering involving the lawyer Willer Tomaz, his companies and Flávio Bolsonaro, with Alexandre de Moraes drawn as rapporteur (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 23/Oct, Moraes authorized lifting the secrecy of the offshore company Alcazar Holdings, owned by Willer Tomaz, and ordered the freezing of up to R$ 6 billion of the lawyer's assets (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo). Flávio Bolsonaro's defense says the relationship between the two is limited to a friendship between the families and calls false the reports that they shared a bank account (Gazeta do Povo). On 20/Oct, a technical note from the Finance Ministry named Willer Tomaz as the country's largest sports-betting gambler in 2025, with R$ 5 billion wagered (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). ⚖️ The government leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues, is collecting signatures for a complaint to the Senate Ethics Council that seeks the loss of Flávio Bolsonaro's mandate for breach of decorum, citing his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro; the document has yet to be filed (Folha de S.Paulo and Valor). ⚖️ On 20/Oct, the Federal Police asked the Supreme Court for more time in the inquiries into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, and Justice Edson Fachin is to decide (Estadão and G1). ⚖️ On 23/Oct, TSE Justice Floriano de Azevedo Marques ruled that only the full court can suspend the Exército do Lula channel on WhatsApp (Agência Brasil and Folha de S.Paulo). In a decision reported on 24/Oct, the TSE barred Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal from posting false content until the election, under a fine of R$ 100 thousand (Folha de S.Paulo), and ordered Meta and X to submit reports every six hours on the posts of the two (G1, Valor and O Globo). ⚖️ On 23/Oct, the TSE's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, made the transport of Indigenous voters by federal agencies in the second round subject to prior approval by the Electoral Court, trip by trip; on 24/Oct, after the Prosecutor General, Paulo Gonet, asked the Supreme Court to suspend that requirement, he reconsidered and simplified the clearance, which no longer depends on reviewing each trip separately (Estadão, O Globo and Agência Brasil). ⚖️ On 16/Oct the TSE plenary unanimously approved rules that link to the campaigns the WhatsApp and other platform channels that receive money, technical support or guidance from them (Gazeta do Povo and G1). On 15/Oct the court ordered the removal of videos by the PL, Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira that link Lula to the alleged INSS frauds (Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and G1).

sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 The names eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) added up to 7.81% of the valid votes. Augusto Cury (2.89%), Ronaldo Caiado (2.18%) and Romeu Zema (0.27%) declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro, and Renan Santos (2.24%) still backs no one. The voters of Augusto Cury, who declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct, go to him by 56% to 27% in PoderData/Aya of 13/Oct and by 50% to 29% in Ipespe of 10/Oct, and to Lula by 50.4% to 38.9% in AtlasIntel of 09/Oct. Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, all three point to Flávio Bolsonaro. 🏆 Counting the closed contracts, the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book is still Lula's, USD 30.28M, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro's, USD 27.06M, and Renan Santos's, which closed at USD 17.12M.
sentimento.polymarket: The winner contract's price is from the confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 20:06 BRT, because this update publishes no new price for the winner contract, and the price of the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment is from the confirmed reading of 25/Oct, 13:39 BRT (16:39 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. The contracts Polymarket closed after the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), those of the eliminated names and of the second-place, third-place and Senate books, drop out of the confirmation because they no longer have a traded price. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move comes the move normalized by the pair's sum, because the sum of prices moves on its own. The poll side of the divergence chart is the second-round Lula × Flávio Bolsonaro pair, in a single national poll and not the average, and always in total votes: today it is Veritá of 24/Oct, n=15,554, with 46.46% for Lula and 49.44% for Flávio Bolsonaro, the largest sample among the day's national polls with total votes. PoderData/Aya is the only national poll with a release registered with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) for 25/Oct, election day, and there is no national poll registered after it.

inss.text1: 📺 In decisions released on 07/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, kept online videos from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign that associate Lula with Alexandre de Moraes and Lulinha with the so-called Careca do [INSS](/en/glossary#inss), and denied the Lula campaign's requests for removal and for a right of reply (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 🗳️ IN THE 04/Oct BALLOT COUNT, POLITICIANS LINKED TO THE INSS FRAUD WERE NOT RE-ELECTED, according to Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo, which note the contrast with those involved in the Master case, several of whom were elected. ⚖️ On 25/Sep Edson Fachin gave the Prosecutor General's Office five days to weigh in on the pending requests in the INSS and Master case investigations, among them requests to review or revoke detentions (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão); the deadline expired on 30/Sep, and the decision on the requests is his.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: This panel's approval benchmark is [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), and its 03/Oct round (BR-02197/2026) measures 44% approval against 49% disapproval. ⚠️ Palver of 03/Oct measures 43% against 56%, according to Exame. Pollsters ask in different ways, and the panel does not add one to another.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep, 44% against 50% on 21/Sep, 46% against 49% on 28/Sep and 44% against 49% on 03/Oct. Approval falls 2 points after two rounds of increase, within the margin of 2pp. ⭐ In the same round's assessment the negative is at 42%, the positive at 33% and the fair rating at 23% (Money Times). These are two different questions and they do not add up.
inss.conclusao: On 01/Oct Lula signed a legal opinion that guarantees victims of domestic violence up to six months of leave with pay covered by the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor). It is a benefit measure, not an act on the queue or on the investigation of the frauds. The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin opened on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to give its opinion on the pending requests in the INSS and Master case investigations expired on 30/Sep. In the polls, government approval ranges from 44.1% in Futura to 49% in Ideia among the national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE'S SUPERIOR COUNCIL KEPT THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL, PAULO GONET, ON THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS AND SHELVED THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE HIS CONDUCT. Against his removal the vote was 9-0. On the inquiry, which stood at 4-3 in favour of opening it with two votes still to be cast, the result was 5-4 for shelving, and the last vote was cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, who was chairing the session because the proceeding involved Gonet himself (G1, Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). The rapporteur, Francisco Sanseverino, pointed out that the messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone do not prove direct contact with the prosecutor-general, and the four defeated council members argued for appointing a deputy prosecutor-general to take the inquiry further, according to G1.
bancoMaster.text2: 📸 ESTADÃO, ON 25/Sep, AND VEJA, ON 26/Sep, REPORT THAT DANIEL VORCARO ATTENDED, ON JANUARY 31, 2024, A LUNCH HOSTED BY GRUPO ESFERA IN HONOR OF GONET, in Brasília, with about 40 guests, which Gilmar Mendes also attended. VEJA publishes the banker's message from that day: "I'll be at the Esfera lunch with Gonet. Gilmar should be there". Gonet says he had no friendship with Vorcaro, and the banker's defense says it rejects the selective disclosure of private conversations. 📅 The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin gave on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to weigh in on the pending requests in the case, among them those linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro, expired on 30/Sep.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ This page's price for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 2.80%, with cumulative volume USD 0.10M, confirmed reading of 25/Oct, 13:39 BRT, 0.05pp above the confirmed reading of 24/Oct at 17:21 BRT. AFOS does not attribute this contract's price to the news flow on the case: it measures the two side by side, with each one's timestamps. 📅 According to Estadão and Folha de S.Paulo on 08/Oct, Gabriel Galípolo reported to the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) unjustified delays by Central Bank staff in the supervision of Master, and Daniel Vorcaro's defence asked Edson Fachin to send his request for release to André Mendonça (O Globo, G1 and Estadão).
bancoMaster.conclusao: 🗳️ AT THE BALLOT BOX, THE CASE SPLIT: Estadão counts 13 politicians linked to Daniel Vorcaro elected on 04/Oct and notes the defeats of Ciro Nogueira and ACM Neto, and Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo note that people involved in the case were elected. The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the proceedings by 9 to 0 and shelved by 5 to 4 the request to investigate his conduct, and Edson Fachin asked the Prosecutor General's Office for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified; the ruling has been stalled since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request for further review. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided. ⚖️ On 02/Oct Edson Fachin created a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo).

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: ⚖️ On 08/Oct, Alexandre de Moraes declared the final judgment (no further appeal) in the case against Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion in the course of proceedings and ordered the start of his 4 years and 2 months sentence in an initial semi-open regime, with his name in the national arrest warrant database, the cancellation of his passports and the suspension of his political rights (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo, Estadão and Valor). Eduardo Bolsonaro lives in the United States and called the decision arbitrary (Gazeta do Povo and VEJA), and Flávio Bolsonaro called on Moraes to resign (Estadão and O Globo). ⚖️ On 06/Oct he requested an opinion from the Office of the Prosecutor-General on Flávio Bolsonaro's new request to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360). The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in that ruling so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified, and proposed internal inquiries; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. ⚖️ On the same day he was the rapporteur of the criminal case in which the Supreme Court convicted former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, 7-3, to one year of detention in an initially open regime for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral.
stf.gilmar: 📺 On 01/Oct he ordered TV Globo to include Renan Santos in the presidential debate, at the request of Solidariedade, after Kassio Nunes Marques and Cármen Lúcia denied the candidate's requests; the broadcaster cancelled the debate the same night (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). On 28/Sep, according to G1, he adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the Master case investigations are identified, and criticized André Mendonça's handling of the case; the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ On 24/Sep he took to the full bench of the Supreme Court a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 📸 Estadão and VEJA report that he was at the Grupo Esfera lunch in honour of Paulo Gonet, on January 31, 2024, which Vorcaro attended, and on 26/Sep he publicly defended Gonet after the shelving (O Globo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.dino: ⚖️ On 27/Sep, in a single-justice ruling on a complaint, he overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required deleting a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida (Jovem Pan and Brasil 247), a decision that Luiz Fux suspended on the night of 28/Sep (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). After the TSE full court released Tabet's post on 30/Sep, on 01/Oct he declared the case moot and closed the action (Gazeta do Povo and Valor). On the same day Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove him from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). On 15/Sep he requested more time to review the case in the trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes. On 02/Oct he publicly defended the rulings of the Supreme Court and the TSE on the TV Globo debate and Justice Estela Aranha (Folha de S.Paulo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.mendonca: His 76-page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Prosecutor General's Office, with a five-day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution. 🗳️ Also on 25/Sep he ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital), and in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro he voted for acquittal, outvoted along with Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques. ⚖️ On 30/Sep, at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) full court, he adjusted his vote to release Antonio Tabet's post and the cases of reasonable doubt, and the court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro the plan to strip the title of patron saint (Gazeta do Povo and G1).
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and there are two recent measurements of different questions, which do not add up. In the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep, 33% say the conduct of the Supreme Court justices hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy more and 23% say it hurts Lula's more (G1). In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg of 23/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more. One question is about the conduct of the justices and the other about the crisis, and both pollsters surveyed the same week.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 2.80%, with cumulative volume USD 0.10M, confirmed reading of 25/Oct, 13:39 BRT, 0.05pp above the confirmed reading of 24/Oct at 17:21 BRT. The price remains far from the series high, 26.10% on 11/Sep. ⚖️ On 18/Oct, Estadão reported, and Folha de S.Paulo and G1 confirmed, that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) (PF) took to the Supreme Court an investigation into suspected money laundering involving the lawyer Willer Tomaz, his companies and Flávio Bolsonaro, with Alexandre de Moraes drawn as rapporteur (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 23/Oct, Moraes authorized lifting the secrecy of the offshore company Alcazar Holdings, owned by Willer Tomaz, and ordered the freezing of up to R$ 6 billion of the lawyer's assets (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo). Flávio Bolsonaro's defense says the relationship between the two is limited to a friendship between the families and calls false the reports that they shared a bank account (Gazeta do Povo). On 20/Oct, a technical note from the Finance Ministry named Willer Tomaz as the country's largest sports-betting gambler in 2025, with R$ 5 billion wagered (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). ⚖️ On 20/Oct, the Federal Police asked the Supreme Court for more time in the inquiries into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, and Justice Edson Fachin is to decide (Estadão and G1). ⚖️ On 23/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse)'s president, Kassio Nunes Marques, made the transport of Indigenous voters by federal agencies in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) subject to prior approval by the Electoral Court, trip by trip; on 24/Oct, after the Prosecutor General, Paulo Gonet, asked the Supreme Court to suspend that requirement, he reconsidered and simplified the clearance, which no longer depends on reviewing each trip separately (Estadão, O Globo and Agência Brasil). ⚖️ On 23/Oct, TSE Justice Floriano de Azevedo Marques ruled that only the full court can suspend the Exército do Lula channel on WhatsApp (Agência Brasil and Folha de S.Paulo). In a decision reported on 24/Oct, the TSE barred Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal from posting false content until the election, under a fine of R$ 100 thousand (Folha de S.Paulo), and ordered Meta and X to submit reports every six hours on the posts of the two (G1, Valor and O Globo). ⚖️ On 13/Oct, Justice Edson Fachin told the Federal Police (PF) director general, Andrei Rodrigues, that mentions of Supreme Court justices in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) investigation must go to the court in a strictly descriptive manner (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 🏛️ Folha de S.Paulo counts 50 elected senators in favour of impeaching Supreme Court justices, below the 54 votes required. ⛔ The panel does not link the contract's price to the day's acts: it measures both with each one's timestamp.
stf.fachin: 🏛️ Edson Fachin received on 06/Oct Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign coordinator, Rogério Marinho, and the Lula government's leader in the Senate (O Globo, CartaCapital and Estadão); Marinho said there will be no revenge against the Supreme Court, but that the Senate will not stand aside (Estadão, Gazeta do Povo and Metrópoles). ⚖️ ON 02/Oct HE CREATED a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). On 01/Oct he denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Flávio Dino from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). The five-day deadline he gave on 25/Sep for the Office of the Prosecutor-General to weigh in on the pending requests in the Master case and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) investigations expired on 30/Sep, and since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention.
